title: Proposal: working together on Fabry disease research

sentences.text: A proposal to work together on research into Fabry disease.
We are writing to the Fabry International Network because you bring together people affected by Fabry disease.
We have not met yet, and we would value your guidance.
Fabry disease is driven by a lysosomal enzyme deficiency with build-up of stored material.
A global pregnancy and breastfeeding registry is recruiting, and a natural history study of IVS4+919G>A variants is active but not recruiting.
Phase 3 migalastat studies in renal disease and in children are underway, and PRX-102 studies in children and in Japanese patients are recruiting.

A contested point: misfolding rescue by a chaperone seems to work only for amenable variants, and in one trial that included non-amenable variants the chaperone did not beat placebo on its main measure.
We would propose a study on [research question about Fabry disease], shaped with your community from the start.
Its design, sites and funding are still to be settled: [study details].

sections.heading: What we would ask of you

sentences.text: Would you be open to discussing this idea with us?
If so, we would like to learn how your member organisations or community might take part, always with proper consent and ethics approval.
We are not asking for any personal information about patients or families.
If this is of interest, could we arrange a short call at a time that suits you?
